systems.name: Brahma (Brahma Graha) Dasa
systems.notImplementedReason: BPHS ch. 46 v. 170-173 does not define "greatest strength" among the 6th/8th/12th lords, the "within the sixth house from the house concerned" condition is read differently in the translations, and the Saturn/Rahu/Ketu clause is ambiguous; the starting sign therefore cannot be fixed without a client ruling.

systems.name: Navamsa Dasa
systems.notImplementedReason: Published versions (Jaimini Sutras ed. S.C. Mishra; Sanjay Rath; I. Rangacharya; P.S. Sastri; Shrimali) disagree on the starting sign for even Lagnas and on the balance at birth; no BPHS rule exists.

systems.name: Varnada Dasa
systems.notImplementedReason: BPHS ch. 6 v. 10-24 (Santhanam; ch. 5 in G.C. Sharma) gives the Varnada Lagna but not whether the "signs intervening" count is inclusive or its direction, how the Varnada of houses 2-12 pairs with the Hora Lagna, or what "clockwise" means; it also needs the Hora Lagna (sunrise convention under ADR-015 rework).

systems.name: Padanadhamsa Dasa
systems.notImplementedReason: No published computation was available to verify (described only in Sanjay Rath's "Narayana Dasa", not accessible here).

systems.name: Tribhagi Dasha
systems.label: provisional – pending client review
systems.source: Tribhagi ("one-third") dasha as published in the Parashari secondary literature and implemented in Jagannatha Hora (P.V.R. Narasimha Rao): the 120-year Vimshottari dasha divided into three 40-year parts. Base Vimshottari order, years and Moon-nakshatra start: BPHS ch. 46 v.12-15 (G.C. Sharma / R. Santhanam tr.); antardasha proportion: BPHS (G.C. Sharma tr.) ch. 51 v.1-2.

systems.name: Shastihayani Dasha
systems.label: provisional – pending client review
systems.source: BPHS ch. 46 v.40-41 (R. Santhanam tr., Ranjan Publications; G.C. Sharma tr.): applicable when the Sun is in the Lagna; lords Jupiter, Sun, Mars, Moon, Mercury, Venus, Saturn, Rahu; Jupiter, Sun and Mars 10 years, the rest 6 (60 years); nakshatra allocation from Ashwini including Abhijit as tabulated in the slokas (table as published by S. Adawal, "Shashtihayani dasa"); balance "as adopted for the Ashtottari system" (Santhanam's example, v.40-41).

systems.name: Tara Dasha
systems.label: provisional – pending client review
systems.source: BPHS ch. 46 v.207-209 (R. Santhanam tr., incl. his illustrative table; G.C. Sharma tr.): "Tara Dasa is like Vimsottari Dasa. Janma, Sampat etc. in their order replace the Sun, Moon etc. housed in Kendras. Applied only where there are planets in Kendras. If there are a number of planets, the first Dasa belongs to the strongest." Strength: Shadbala, BPHS ch. 27.

systems.name: Patyayini Dasha (Tajika annual)

systems.source: Patyayini dasa of the Tajaka writers (Tajika Neelakanthi tradition), krisamsa/patyamsa procedure as stated in P.V.R. Narasimha Rao, "Vedic Astrology: An Integrated Approach", ch. 30.3 (Patyayini Dasa), steps (1)-(4) and Table 75.

systems.name: Moola Dasha (Lagna Kendradi graha dasha)
systems.label: provisional – pending client review
systems.source: P.V.R. Narasimha Rao, Vedic Astrology: An Integrated Approach, 19.1; S. Rath, srath.com "Mula dasa".
systems.notImplementedReason: Moola (Lagna Kendradi graha) dasha could not be defined unambiguously from a published source. P.V.R. Narasimha Rao ("Vedic Astrology: An Integrated Approach", 19.1) names it ("Vimsottari years with moolatrikona correction") but declares it out of scope. S. Rath (srath.com, "Mula dasa - Varahamihira's success") gives years = Vimshottari years - (count from the planet to its moolatrikona sign - 1), +/-1 for exaltation/debility, without the counting direction, and his worked table (Cancer Lagna, Sri Rama) cannot be reproduced with one consistent direction (Jupiter 10 needs a reverse count, Moon 10 a forward count, Saturn 14 neither). Birth balance and antardasha rules are not stated. Pending client methodology.
